about: The secreta of the formulary “Christ the King” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O Lord, we offer You this sacrificial Victim of mankind’s reconciliation with You; grant, we beseech You, that He whom we offer in this present sacrifice may Himself bestow upon all peoples the gifts of unity and peace, Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,
